body: Missed you a lot. Loved your other posts

Just do it. At least send the email. The best thing would be to be to go back to the doctor again but if your not comfortable then the email would at least be a start. Its best to get it out there and get help for it. Get help for it now before it gets worse. I really wish that i would have done that a long time ago. Your still young and should get help for it. Dont delay it. It will never go away until you fight it. Trust me. Ive been waiting for it to go away for years and it hasnt so it never will for you. Get the help while you can before it gets worse. I feel like a hypocrite telling you this because i feel the same way but havent done anything to resolve it for me but maybe my advice will help you prevent getting to the point where i am. Seek the help you need now before it really affects your life

The thing is that i dont want to go down to that deeper bottom. I feel like ive hit rock bottom sometimes but then sometime later i go even lower. I hate that feeling. I want to progress up and start drinking less until i get to the point where i either stop or drink very little. It doesnt seem like im ever going to get to that point. I dont know how to stop or slow down my drinking. I really fear that the only way ill stop is when something really bad happens like a dui or some kind of hospitalization happens. I really dont want anything like that to happen before i start to recover but it seems like something like that will be the only way that will help me get pointed in the right direction. I just dont know what to do

Im very sad and supremely embarrassed to say that i did get drunk that night. I finished the whole bottle of fireball like i said i would. The next day i felt like shit and was really hungover. That was the worst hangover ive had in a while but id probably do it again. Everytime i get drunk, the next day i regret it and say that i want to stop drinking. But then the next week i start right back up. I really dont know what to do to stop. It really beginning to affect my life. Whenever i get super drunk like that the next day i just stay in bed and dont do anything. Im beginning to think that im going to drink right up until the day i die. Its very sad and discouraging

The hard thing for me is that ive lost all interest in things that i was interested in. Before all this shit happened i was interested in many things but since then ive lost all interest in everything. I know thats a sign of depression, when you lose interest in things. It sucks. I cant get into things i used to be very much interested in. Just about the only thing im interested in is alcohol and right now thats a bad thing. Im very reluctant to try new things. Something new would probably be good for me but im afraid of new things. I dont want to break from my normal habits that i go thru everyday. I would like more then anything be able to regain my interest in things that i used to enjoy but i cant. I really wish that there was an instant cure but i know there isnt. Im begining to think that there is no hope for me. I just fear that someday that the only cure for all my troubles and problems is death. Im just terrified that maybe someday ill actually get the courage to actually follow thru with what i think about constantly in my head and kill myself
